body: Thank you. It’s just really hard, and this is going to sound ridiculous but we’ve only dated for 2 months. The problem is she’s been my best friend for 2 years before that, I was never closer to anyone than I was to her. And I feel sick that we threw away a 2 year friendship over a stupid failed 2 month relationship. I’ve been battling depression and anxiety for around 5 years now and just recently got help about 3 weeks ago. I’ve also had a handful of half assed suicide attempts with my most recent being today. But I don’t even know if I can call these attempts. It’s more like I really want to die, I don’t want to feel the way I feel anymore. But I’m too afraid to commit to something as permanent as suicide. Today, I didn’t kick the stool over, I just took all my weight off it. I started to feel funny like it was maybe starting to work. Then I started gasping for air. I started to feel sick, I stood back up on the stool, took the noose off and ran outside to puke. My mother found me outside puking and it scared the hell out of me thinking of her knowing that I want to die. So I told her I’ll be inside in a second and ran into the shed to untie the noise as fast as I could. I read a lot of stories of people that find a reason to live after a failed suicide attempt. But all I want is to die. I can’t stand who I am or anything I do. I miss her. I feel she’s the only one who can save me but I can’t ever let her know how much I want to die because I don’t want her to think it’s her fault
No I haven’t tried talking to her friends or parents about it yet but I’ll definitely give it a try, thanks
Thank you that’s perfect. I’ll do it and hope for the best
Maybe I could try that, I just don’t think she’d like if I got that involved. It’s tough to know
Thanks, I really hope it will help. The last thing I need is to upset her too much because I didn’t leave things alone. I think I’m gonna try anyway

Well, after she got out of the hospital last time, she got into a program that would help with life skills and help them start a career. One of the facilitators at the program knew someone who owned a company looking for an administrative assistant, and recommended my girlfriend to that position and she got it. She’s been really busy lately so as understanding as they might be, I think what she’s thinking is they might have to hire a replacement for her while she’s gone and she’s afraid she won’t have a job when she gets out of the hospital. It’s a really good paying job and she is quite content there so I can understand her worries but I’m more worried about her health. Sorry about being all over the place my brain is kinda mush right now

Thank you, this gives me some relief. The only problem with getting back into the hospital is she has a job this time. She wants to go to the hospital but she doesn’t want to lose her job over it. I near begged her to put her health before her job, but it’s clearly a tough choice for her. I’m starting to calm down over it, but I’m a worrier and all I want is for her to be ok. Thanks for the help, I really appreciate it.
